name: Cypriot Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 spoon of feta cheese, cut into small pieces

steps: Put them in a bowl and decorate them with onions, feta cheese and olives. If you want you can decorate your bowl with every way!
Before serving, add salad and olive oil with lemon and shake.

culture.text: Traditional salad (Χωριάτικη σαλάτα) is a salad that can be served together with most foods in Cyprus.
